supabase.description: Supabase MCP: database, migrations, Edge Functions, logs, and docs for this project. You will be prompted to log in to Supabase in the browser on first use.

resend.description: Resend MCP: send emails, manage contacts, broadcasts, domains, webhooks.

stripe.description: Stripe MCP: customers, payments, invoices, refunds, products, subscriptions, docs. Uses OAuth on first use.

github.description: GitHub MCP: repos, issues, PRs, search (no Docker required).

cloudflare.description: Cloudflare MCP: full API (Workers, KV, R2, D1, DNS, etc.) via search & execute. OAuth on first use.

github-actions.description: GitHub Actions MCP: get latest failed run logs and extract errors (workflow failure analysis).
